scope: Direct native Current rule and authority conflicts; no instance migration, runtime or Workbench changes.

findings.finding: Whitelist limits relational classifications to R/Goal, R/Demand and Plan. Reconcile all RMEDO Scope Delegations; preserve the actual Claim-target distinction for Plan and other still-valid classifications. Same Summary if meaning stays registration.

findings.summary: Let Direct Parents Define Non-Project Goals
findings.finding: Requires every non-Project unit to have >=1 direct-parent Goal; conflicts with exactly one external Scope Delegation and Project-only Goal. Summary itself states superseded policy: retire and use a new-ID delegation authority, preserving structural visibility and gap reporting under a suitable owner.

findings.summary: Distinguish Implementation Methods from Implementation Decisions
findings.finding: Old Eng Policy/Decision vs Delivery Policy/Decision terminology plus actual-child and every-child test conflicts with shared Form admissions, leaf-local policies and Direct/Approach behavior. Preserve Method versus Delivery distinction, no technology-name inference and no type-tier coupling, where applicable.

findings.summary: Limit PROGRAMMATIC Method and Delivery Types
findings.finding: Only old Method/Delivery Forms allowed in PROGRAMMATIC and policy ownership requires a real child; align admitted shared Forms and leaf-local policy, while preserving applicable scope, incomplete Draft allowance and no claim of instance/runtime migration.

findings.summary: Define local Scope Contract Tier Zero
findings.finding: Defines Tier 0 as Scope Contract and higher tiers as specializations/realizations. Replace obsolete Scope Contract authority with Tier 0 internal unit definition under a new identity if Summary changes. Preserve Project Goal Tier -1 under its separate existing rule; do not invent a Form-to-Tier restriction.

Requires Requirement/Scope Unit Declaration. One external Scope Delegation can have any RMEDO Role and merges structural identity/responsibility. Its Summary defines superseded Form; new declaration/admission identities needed. Preserve external context and receiving Main Subject.

Requires every unit including Project to have a Requirement Scope Unit Declaration, with no Project ID. Separate Project-root authority/bootstrap from exactly one non-Project external RMEDO Scope Delegation; preserve stable ID, Name, order/parent constraints and authoritative structural binding. Reconcile existing root-ID/world decisions without inventing a world Declaration. Summary may require new identity.
Keeps independent Decision topology (valid); obsolete detail says leaf cannot own Policy. Remove obsolete prohibition; adapt Eng Decision naming without requiring a policy link.

Childless-Atom policy permission is not a Scope Unit parent prohibition. Remove detail denying local Policy at a leaf; inspect whether absorption-conditioned permission stays relevant under new Forms.

findings.summary: Absorb Implementation Decisions without semantic loss
findings.finding: Preserve lossless decision absorption safeguard; remove forced policy relocation/reclassification when last Scope Unit child disappears. Align old Form references, do not invent auto-conversion.

Formal Tier.Label maps Tier 0 to Scope Contract. Remove or replace this hard-coded mapping as part of tier authority cutover; preserve property cardinality and any independently accepted other labels.

findings.summary: Author Scope Unit Declarations and Contracts
findings.finding: Method describes authoring declarations and Scope Contract Atoms at Tier 0; align to merged external delegation and internal Tier 0 without losing structural verification. Inspect entire Current method and any Draft when preparing successor.
Evaluation enforces Tier 0 Scope Contract label. Update expected criteria to accepted tier semantics while preserving Role-content validation and no universal role-count requirement.

findings.summary: Validate Methodology membership in the Project
findings.finding: Project Configuration evaluation embeds Project Scope Contract-first checks. Rebase the obsolete label and checks while retaining separately supported methodology ancestry and invalid-structure coverage; do not interpret source rewrite as passed Evaluation.

Current serialization narrows PROGRAMMATIC to old Forms and emits their tokens. Coordinate with Delivery owner for new Form serialization, preserving unrelated existing filename behavior; instance and runtime migration remain later.

notes: No direct leaf-only realization prohibition was located in bounded Core/Project Configuration Current-source search; do not claim absence elsewhere. The actual-child policy ownership prohibitions above are separate and directly evidenced.
Default local R Form names and default child Scope Delegation admission remain undecided. Preserve independent Decision and inherited constraints; no generic mandatory contribution link.

Current legacy instances, Workbench and Workflows are outside this report and may remain nonconforming until later migration. Source promotion and model authority cutover require atomic coordination and review; proposed amendments are not applied.

Old CA-R-2119, CA-R-2120, CA-R-2267 and CA-R-2268 are cited by R1767/R2123, but no native Current source located by ID in the bounded methodology tree; citations are not evidence of a Current authority.
